A max-heap is constructed from an array $[10, 20, 15, 30, 40, 50, 60, 25]$ using Floyd's bottom-up `BUILD-MAX-HEAP` algorithm. What is the value at index 2 (1-indexed, root at index 1) after the heap is built?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Array: indices 1 to 8: $[10, 20, 15, 30, 40, 50, 60, 25]$.
Leaves are indices 5 to 8 ($40, 50, 60, 25$).
Heapify at index 4 (value 30, child 8 with value 25): unchanged.
Heapify at index 3 (value 15, children 6 and 7 with values 50, 60): swap 15 with 60 $\rightarrow$ index 3 becomes 60.
Heapify at index 2 (value 20, children 4 and 5 with values 30, 40): swap 20 with 40 $\rightarrow$ index 2 becomes 40.
Heapify at index 1 (value 10, children 2 and 3 with values 40, 60): swap 10 with 60 $\rightarrow$ index 1 is 60, index 3 gets 10, which swaps with 50.
Index 2 retains value 40.
